principle: A resource can exist and still be intentionally non-targetable until its source repository exposes verified Mentor metadata.

gaps.issue: Crechè exposes 52 child adventures through one Adventure Garden resource rather than individually manifested activity records.
gaps.effect: Mentor can recommend the garden broadly but cannot make defensible lesson-to-specific-adventure claims from the root manifest alone.

gaps.issue: Bazaar Art's Mentor manifest exposes the specialist repository root rather than verified child courses/studios.
gaps.effect: Visual-art objectives can route to Bazaar as exploration, but Art 101/201/301 and studios should not be treated as individually Mentor-owned until deep inventory is promoted.

gaps.issue: Solanar exposes the Observatory root as the verified inventory authority while child weather/science paths continue expanding.
gaps.effect: Weather/Earth-system mapping is valid at hub level but not yet child-app precise.

gaps.issue: River-to-Road currently exposes its root environmental/service-learning gateway.
gaps.effect: Mentor can align environmental stewardship/service learning to the hub, but event/tool-level targeting awaits a deep inventory.

gaps.issue: Firmament is currently a root-level legal/research federation anchor.
gaps.effect: Law/civics objectives should route only to the verified hub until its child legal-study resources are enumerated.

gaps.issue: The repository registry records Finance as discovered rather than validly manifested for recommendation.
gaps.effect: Do not automatically route financial-reasoning objectives into Finance yet; use existing Khaemenes curriculum/internal tools until a source manifest is verified.
